players.product: NOR flash (server BIOS / boot) and SLC NAND

quarterly_data.signal: Macronix Q2 2026 results deck: net sales NT$19,125 million, up 83% QoQ (1Q26 NT$10,469 million) and 181% YoY (2Q25 NT$6,799 million); gross margin 64.4% (1Q26 40.8%, 2Q25 15.6%); operating income NT$8,968 million (operating margin 46.9%, vs 18.5% in 1Q26 and -15.9% in 2Q25); net income NT$7,736 million; basic EPS NT$3.91. 1H26 net sales NT$29,593 million, up 129% YoY, with gross margin 56.1% and operating margin 36.8%.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 net sales NT$19,125 million (+83% QoQ, +181% YoY); GM 64.4%; OPM 46.9%; EPS NT$3.91

quarterly_data.signal: Macronix Q2 2026 parent-company sales by product: NOR +48% QoQ and +101% YoY; NAND (incl. eMMC) +163% QoQ and +798% YoY; ROM +40% QoQ and +37% YoY; Foundry Business Group +20% QoQ and -1% YoY. Within NAND, eMMC sales rose 317% QoQ and 5,334% YoY and other NAND (SLC / MLC / TLC) 73% QoQ and 315% YoY. NOR by application: Computer +63% QoQ / +177% YoY, Communication +56% / +121%, Consumer +46% / +77%, Industrial-Medical-Aerospace +29% / +42%, Automotive +15% / +11%.
quarterly_data.figure: NOR +48% QoQ / +101% YoY; NAND +163% QoQ / +798% YoY; eMMC +317% QoQ; computer NOR +63% QoQ / +177% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: Macronix business update: NOR is under strong demand in all segments, with prices also reflecting market trends, and high-density NOR remains in undersupply with demand increasing. In NAND, the SLC NAND and eMMC structural shortage remains, and the company says capacity will be expanded to meet demand.
Macronix capex plan: an incremental capex budget of NTD 15.8 bn for advanced capacity. Q2 2026 capital expenditures were NT$479 million (1Q26 NT$218 million) and free cash flow NT$7,360 million.
quarterly_data.figure: incremental capex budget NTD 15.8 bn for advanced capacity

quarterly_data.signal: Macronix says eMMC for automotive will be shipped in 2027; the automotive sector continues to maintain stable demand, and high-density NOR for automotive is shifting toward SLC NAND.
